36. **File the six fleet-library hygiene findings upstream? (opened 2026-11-22, fleet-libs refresh question 2.)** go-business-rules v2.2.1 without a CHANGELOG section and with a stale version string; go-sse missing a 0.7.0 section; go-error-family's four never-tagged modules; go-cqrs-lite's `idempotency/sqlstore` pin skew; templ-components' grid-variable CSP emission; the adminui anchor-name pair. Recommendation (recorded, not executed): file each in its library repo after verifying at source, or triage one digest first.

37. **go-appkit v0.13.1 from master to clear the fleet's only lag? (opened 2026-11-22, fleet-libs refresh question 3.)** The v0.13.0 tag declares `go 1.27.4`; master already declares `go 1.27` and is 10 commits ahead. A v0.13.1 cut would let the fleet sweep without waiting for nixpkgs 1.27.4. Owner's call: it interacts with the fleet-floor decision in row 1.

38. **Extend the fleet-libs series to the six pinned sibling repos outside the 23-library audit? (opened 2026-11-22.)** go-flightrecorder, go-legalparty, go-sqlitestore, go-ndjson, samber-do-auditlog and the branded-ID library are pinned in the workspace but have no report. Each new report bumps the libs-report-count baseline.
### Fleet-libs refresh low items (2026-11-22 status report §f)
_Trigger-gated and low items from §f of the 2026-11-22 fleet-libs refresh status report. Each needs its trigger or decision before becoming a task._

- **§f21 — idemtest companion rule across the fleet.** Check other go-idempotency consumers against the library-policy rule; if hand-rolled guard tests recur, ship the drills inside usermgmt so every consumer inherits compliance.
- **§f23 — legalparty-model tag decision.** Tag legalparty-model, or record why it stays unreleased while its value layer ships as go-legalparty v0.1.0. Owner-gated.

- **§f24 — go-health-dashboard bump check.** At the next pin bump, verify the bridge forwards the upstream OIDC and ops options (`WithOIDC`, per-IP rate limit, request logging) and decide what setup exposes.
- **§f25 — grid-variable CSP allowance verdict.** Record, per surface, whether templ-components v1.27.2's grid-variable inline style needs the `unsafe-hashes` allowance (setup-demo carries it today).
- **§f29 — templ-components Sparkline and Bar for dashboardui.** Upstream growth in v1.27.1 not yet used here; evaluate it for the throughput panel.
- **§f30 — SSE buffer sizing via `DefaultSubscriberBuffer`.** Replace the literal 64 in the go-sse subscriber sizing with the named v0.7.0 knob.
- **§f31 — go-datastar static version constants.** Use, or record N/A for, the v0.8.0 `Version1_0_4` and `VersionIsValid` constants (the embedded JS is still v1.0.4).
- **§f32 — cosmetic N/A rows.** Name go-health `tools/doanalyzerv2` and templ-components `website` in their reports as not applicable.

- **§f33 — index design nits.** A third vision pass after the caption edits, then caption contrast (about 4 to 1), the two-line not-adopted badge, the scroll-spy highlight and the hero shape baseline.
- **§f34 — module count derived in the freshness gate.** Derive the module count in the freshness gate from the go.work member list (31 sub-entries today) so the AGENTS figure cannot lag again.

- **§f26 — process lessons for the skill runbook (not project work).** Dead subagents can leave committed edits; provider failover facts; two concurrent subagents after a rate-limit; a script-generated fact sheet. Owner-gated global memory.
